title: DM ads
hook: Setty, sitting on the boardroom table, to the coach standing by his ad dashboard: You paid Meta to fill your [bleep]ing DMs, right?
biais: aversion à la perte (l'argent des pubs, les sérieux qui partent chez un autre)
pertinence pour soi (son tableau de bord)
cta: Comment SETTY (he sends everything to build your AI setter for free)
caption:
Comment "SETTY" and he'll send you everything to build a free AI setter that answers the DMs your ads bring in. Follow so the DM lands 📩

👇 READ BELOW: what "Messaging conversations started" really counts, from Meta's own help center.

1. In Ads Manager, "Messaging conversations started" counts people who messaged you after your ad. It doesn't tell you if anyone answered.

2. So 300 conversations started can mean 300 hellos sitting in your inbox. Lots of people click with no real need, and the serious ones move on to whoever answers first.

3. The ad did its job: it opened the chat. What happens next decides the sale.

4. Setty is the AI setter I built for coaches: Manychat keeps your ad trigger and sends the first message, and Setty takes over when the lead replies. He asks your questions one at a time, in your voice, and only the right leads get your calendar.

The catch: Setty can't make a bad ad profitable, and no tool can promise a number of calls. He answers the conversations your ad already started. Building and testing him are free with no card, then going live starts a 14-day trial at $119/month per live setter.

Comment "SETTY" and he'll send you everything to build your AI setter for free.
